picks.rationale: Concrete end-to-end result: a Stanford-built virtual biotech of tens of thousands of AI agents mined clinical trials and proposed a cancer therapy a pharma company then pursued independently.
picks.excerpt: Stanford researchers built a virtual biotech staffed by tens of thousands of AI agents that mined thousands of clinical trials and proposed a cancer therapy later pursued independently by a major pharma company.
picks.headline: Virtual biotech company puts thousands of AI scientist agents to work on drug discovery

picks.rationale: Paper2Agent is a usable research tool, not commentary — it turns a published manuscript into an interactive agent that can answer method questions and collaborate with other paper agents.
picks.excerpt: Stanford's Paper2Agent converts scientific manuscripts into interactive agents that answer questions about their own methods and collaborate with other paper agents to generate new findings.
picks.headline: Manuscripts-turned AI agents can now 'talk' to each other and make new discoveries

picks.rationale: A named, shipped model — IBM and NASA's open Lunar Foundation Model trained on decades of orbiter data — richly reported with strong imagery, and a rare geospatial/space entry in the mix.
picks.excerpt: IBM and NASA built the Lunar Foundation Model, an open geospatial AI trained on decades of lunar orbiter data to map the moon's surface at unprecedented detail.
picks.headline: Powerful new AI model will map the moon's surface in more detail than ever, NASA and IBM scientists say

picks.rationale: First-party method write-up from a credible lab: Retrieve-for-Train removes the inference bottleneck in large-scale AI search over combinatorial scientific and engineering problems.
picks.excerpt: Google Research describes Retrieve-for-Train, a method that removes the inference bottleneck in large-scale AI search pipelines used for combinatorial scientific and engineering problems.
picks.headline: Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train

picks.rationale: A concrete modelling result with a planning payoff — decades of weather variability run through an AI model to size batteries and hydrogen storage for reliable renewable grids.
picks.excerpt: A new AI approach models decades of weather variability to show how batteries and hydrogen storage can be sized to keep renewable grids reliable.
picks.headline: Using AI to plan for climate variability in renewable energy systems
